name: Klukai

skills.name: Swift Strike
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Pinpoint Detonation
skills.description:
Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles, dealing Corrosion damage equal to 80% of attack. Performs an additional attack, deals AoE Corrosion damage equal to 60% of attack to the target and all enemy targets within 3 tiles, pulling all affected enemy targets 1 tile towards the center.

If any enemy targets are killed, reduces the cooldown of the Ultimate skill Devastating Drift by 1 turn, and gains 2 points of Confectance Index.

If no enemy targets are killed, applies 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion to the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Overpowering Corrosion
skills.description: Selects 1 tile within a 8 tiles, dealing AoE Corrosion damage equal to 90% of attack to all enemy targets within 3 tiles, and applies Toxic Infiltration for 2 turns. Increases damage by 15% to targets already affected by Toxic Infiltration.

skills.name: Devastating Drift
skills.description: Selects 1 tile within a cross-shaped area of 4 to 8 tiles, landing on the selected tile and dealing AoE Corrosion damage equal to 100% of attack to all enemy targets in a 5 tiles wide path. Gains 6 tiles of Additional Movement. If 2 or more targets are killed, this skill can be used again. up to a maximum of 1 additional time.

skills.name: Elite's Pride
skills.description:
Immune to all negative Control-type tile effects. When dealing damage with active attacks, applies 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion to the target for 2 turns, and gains 1 stack of Competitive Spirit after skill usage.

Each time Klukai performs an active attack or other allied units deal Corrosion damage, Klukai gains 1 point of Confectance Index. For every 3 points of Confectance Index gained, reduces the cooldown of her Ultimate skill by 1 turn.

fortification.effect:
Increases damage dealt to targets that are already inflicted with Toxic Infiltration by 30%.

If the target is not killed from this damage, it can also trigger the on-death effect of Toxic Infiltration.

Toxic Infiltration has a new effect: At the end of the action of the unit which possesses this effect, the inflictor applies Toxic Infiltration to enemy units within 3 tiles that do not possess Toxic Infiltration for 2 turns.

At the start of the battle, gains 3 stacks of Competitive Spirit. When other allied units deal Corrosion damage, Klukai can gain 1 stack of Competitive Spirit. Increases the stack limit of Competitive Spirit by 4 stacks. 

For every 3 points of Confectance Index gained, applies an additional 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion to enemy units with Corrosive Infusion, and reduces the cooldown of Klukai's Ultimate skill by 1 turn.

Corrosive Infusion gains a new affect: When Klukai performs an active attack or other allied units deal Corrosion damage, applies an additional 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion to targets with Corrosive Infusion. Defense is reduced by 1%, and the stack limit is increased by 5 stacks.

For each enemy hit, increases damage dealt by an additional 10%, up to a maximum of 50%. If a Boss is hit, this increase will be immediately raised to the maximum value 50%. 

If 2 or more targets or a Boss is hit, this skill can be used again, up to a maximum of 1 additional time. Before attacking, applies Defense Down II and Toxic Infiltration to the target for 2 turns.

Increases damage dealt by the first damage instance to 100% of attack. For each stack of Corrosive Infusion on the target, the damage multiplier of the additional attack is increased by 5%. If a phase weakness is exploited, the attack ignores 15% of the target's Cover damage reduction.

Effective range is increased by 2 tiles, damage increases to 110% of attack. Toxic Infiltration spread radius increases by 1 tile, and the damage it deals increases to 80% of attack. If the target is inflicted with a Corrosion debuffs, applies Toxic Infiltration for 2 turns before the attack.

Toxic Infiltration gains an additional effect: When receiving an active attack from Klukai, damage taken is increased by 30%.

Ignores Cover damage reduction.

Increases width by 2 tiles and applies Dismay for 2 turns.

After the attack, triggers all enemies' effects of Corrosive Infusion and the on-death effects of Toxic Infiltration.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Deadly Entwine
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, if there is only one target, applies 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion to them for 2 turns. Additionally, gains 2 points of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - One Fell Swoop
keys.effect: If the Ultimate skill Devastating Drift only hits 1 target, increases the damage dealt by 30%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - No Mercy
keys.effect: Corrosive Infusion gains a new effect, it increases damage to targets in Stability Break by 15%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Strong Support
keys.effect: For every Support Attack performed by other allied units, gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Limit Break
keys.effect: Reduces the width of the Ultimate skill Devastating Drift's effective area to 3 tiles. For each tile reduced, increases damage dealt by 10%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Moment of Doom
keys.effect: After the unit(s) afflicted with Toxic Infiltration take damage from its effect and survive, they are inflicted with 1 stack of Corrosive Infusion for 2 turns.

keys.name: Common Key - Murderous Return
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / At the start of the turn, if the user's Confectance Index is full, the next instance of AoE damage inflicted by an active attack is increased by 10%.

keys.name: Expansion Key - The Pride of Elite Doll
keys.effect:
At the start of combat, summon Fang drone to follow Klukai. Fang is not targetable and not considered a separate summoned unit. 

After an active attack done by Klukai, Fang attacks 3 nearest enemy targets, dealing AoE Corrosion damage equal to 100% of Klukai ATK that ignores cover, and applies 1 stack of Toxic Infiltration. The damage multiplier is increased by 10% each time the Corrosive Infusion effect or the on-death effect of Toxic Infiltration is triggered.

When Corrosive Infusion effect is triggered, the damage coefficient of Corrosive Infusion is increased for each stack of Competitive Spirit by an additional 1% .
